paper_scope.system: welded crossed nanowire junction under conserved phase-field evolution
paper_scope.question: How does the spatial placement of a finite kinetic barrier change first-fragmentation time and site?
paper_scope.simulation_scope_note: The package completed 1650 untreated and 1550 c34.5 fine-grid continuation proposals, a 120-step source-A untreated detector replay, and 6660 proposals in four frozen weaker-contrast treatment branches. The archived B/C transport recurrence analysis performed no new simulation.

model_scope.physical_scope_caveat: The imposed mobility field is fixed in space and is not a material-following or advected coating.

roy_two_arm_reproduction.definition: at least two of the same distal arms detached at all three thresholds for one observation and two later observations

uniform_run_clock.definition: physical time reported by the K3 uniform-mobility trajectory

reduced_domain_elapsed.definition: elapsed physical time after the separately matched reduced-domain source

claims.statement: The source-semantic R6 reproduction gives a robust two-arm event bracket of 1710-1720, within the reported Roy comparison window of 1600-1800.
claims.not_supported: This clock is not the production first-single-arm clock and cannot be used for treatment differences.

claims.statement: At fixed width and mobility contrast in seed 2292, barrier placement produces a sign-changing first-event-time response and changes the first-failure site between junction-adjacent and remote modes.
claims.scope: The c14.5, c22.5, and c64.5 cases are calibration anchors; c18.5, c26.5, c30.5, c34.5, and c38.5 complete the exploratory interpolation scan.

claims.statement: Source A supplied the exploratory placement ordering. Independently conditioned sources B and C each confirmed that c18.5 delays and relocates failure remotely, c26.5 delays junction-adjacent failure, and c34.5 accelerates junction-adjacent failure.

At the same source-weighted mobility-deficit budget, off-junction collars outlast both a junction-centered cap and uniform suppression, so treatment amount alone does not explain the terminal response.
claims.scope: One source only. K1, K2, and K3 are equal-budget controls, not independent replicates.

claims.statement: The spectral control-volume audit, separated into axial and in-plane-transverse contributions, supports sign-changing redistribution: c26.5 reduces natural-zone depletion, c34.5 and c38.5 increase it, and c64.5 is near-null.
claims.scope: Instantaneous t=1300 reconstruction in seed 2292; not a continuous integrated transport law.

claims.statement: All 12 primary-panel trajectories retain a connected weld at the exact first-event candidate, while treated weld radii at common t=1500 are smaller than paired untreated values.
The harmful c34.5 timing and junction-adjacent mode survive paired timestep refinement from dt=1 to dt=0.5.
A separately matched reduced in-plane R6 domain preserves the protective and harmful sign and site classes.
claims.scope: This is a same-seed reduced-domain gate, not an independent source, grid refinement, or radius-scale transfer.

claims.statement: A factor-two common-source continuation-grid refinement preserves the harmful c34.5 shift at -100 model time units and the junction-adjacent first-failure class.
claims.scope: This is common-source continuation-grid robustness from a periodically prolonged mature t=120 field, not source formation from t=0, radius/interface-width convergence, or a sharp-interface limit.

claims.statement: An exact deterministic replay of the source-A untreated trajectory supplies the previously unavailable t=1710 field and reproduces the production event bracket 1690-1700 and site 19.25 with the modern three-record detector.
claims.scope: The replay harmonizes detector provenance for an existing trajectory; it is not an independent source, parameter study, or new physical result.

claims.statement: At the weaker tested suppression, m_min=0.3, independent confirmation sources B and C both retained junction-adjacent delay at c26.5 (+200 each) and junction-adjacent advance at c34.5 (-60 each).
claims.scope: The comparison tests two discrete mobility factors, 0.1 and 0.3. It does not establish a continuous dose-response curve, a threshold, monotonic magnitude scaling, or contrast independence.

claims.statement: Archived source-B and source-C fields reproduced the intermediate and outboard signs of the weak-zone rate change in all 24 arm records. Twenty-three armwise reconstructions closed below one percent; one source-C outboard arm closed at 1.1575 percent, so the strict all-arm gate did not pass.
claims.scope: This is a no-new-simulation analysis of archived confirmation-source fields. It supports recurrence of the signed transport response but is not a passed validation gate or a universal lifetime mechanism.

claims.statement: On the common source-A t=100 field, the diffuse-interface-weighted mobility deficits of the c26.5 and c34.5 primary masks are 2245.1711634743924 and 2246.252630042341, a 0.048168557727021805 percent difference relative to c26.5.
claims.scope: This is a descriptive source-A initial-state diagnostic. The budgets are nearly matched but not exactly equal; exact equality applies only to the geometric full-domain mask integral.

claims.statement: At common t=1300, while all eight source-A welds remain connected, the five placements for which the fixed probe lies outside collar support and the first-event mode is common show a post-hoc descriptive association between four-arm mean phase-radius response and corrected lifetime shift (Pearson r=0.949, n=5).
claims.scope: This is a post-hoc descriptive association within exploratory source A. The all-eight r=0.980 association is retained only as a confounded sensitivity calculation because its three remote-event cases are exactly the three probe/collar-overlap cases. No fitted lifetime law, inferential population result, or independently calibrated predictor is supported.

claims.statement: The same four-arm mean phase-radius observable has the protective c26.5 sign and harmful c34.5 sign from the first stored diagnostic at t=700 in sources A-C, at least 850 model-time units before an event-bracket lower bound. The frozen t=1300 and t=1500 checks pass in both independent confirmation sources B and C (8/8), and the separately frozen three-contour weak-zone audit remains passed at 24/24 checks.
claims.scope: Sources B and C confirm two representative placement signs, not the continuous eight-position curve. Arms are correlated diagnostics and are not counted as replicates.

primary_mask_budget_summary.definition: integral of 16*cbar^2*(1-cbar)^2*(1-m) over the common source field, with cbar clipped to [0,1]

uniform_rescaling.reporting_rule: Report as agreement within one diagnostic interval, not as sub-time-step precision.

transport_confirmation_summary.interpretation: supporting signed recurrence with one marginal continuity-tolerance miss

precursor_synthesis_summary.source_a_primary_subset_definition: probe outside collar support and common first-event mode

exclusions: No universal placement law or phase boundary is established.
No R12 or multi-radius scale-transfer claim is supported by this package.
The completed spatial check is common-source continuation-grid robustness, not full source-from-t=0 spatial convergence or a sharp-interface limit.
No experiment or material calibration is included.
The fixed Eulerian mobility landscape is not an advected coating model.
The position scan is discovery/interpolation, not independent external validation.
The primary source-A morphology/lifetime correlation is a post-hoc descriptive five-case association within one source; no p-value, fitted lifetime law, or population-prediction claim is supported.

The all-eight source-A morphology/lifetime correlation is confounded by exact coincidence between the three remote-event cases and the three probe/collar-overlap cases; it is sensitivity context, not primary evidence.
The matched source-B/source-C precursor analysis confirms c26.5 and c34.5 signs at two times, not the continuous eight-position response.
Source A is exploratory discovery evidence and is not counted as confirming placements selected from its own scan; sources B and C are the two independent confirmations.

The primary transport decomposition is source A at one instantaneous time; archived sources B and C provide supporting signed recurrence with one marginal continuity-tolerance miss, not a passed validation gate.
Two mobility factors are tested; no continuous contrast law, threshold, monotonic magnitude scaling, or contrast independence is established.
The equal-budget K1/K2/K3 comparison is one source.
Arms and simultaneous sites within a trajectory are correlated.
Event midpoints are bracket summaries with five-time-unit half-width, not exact breakup times.
The Roy two-arm reproduction clock is context only and is excluded from production treatment differences.
The equal-budget K2 junction cap is not the c22.5 position-scan case.
The reduced-domain gate is not an independent source or scale-transfer result.
The source-A detector replay is measurement-provenance validation and is not an independent source or robustness axis.
No nested-width, pulse-release, kernel, adjoint, selector, or other Acta-oriented claim is imported.
